sections.title: Fortunes
sections.summary:
Fortunes are a new set of items that each add unique mechanics which enhance and reward specific playstyles. Each Fortune comes with buffs, drawbacks, and some unique effects.
A Tarnished may have one Major Fortune and one Minor Fortune active at a time.

=== Martyr Saint Shrines ===
Martyr Saint Shrines are new points of interest placed around the world, representing an oracle Martyr.
When interacted with, they will grant an Oracle's Remedy.
Shrines are indicated by very bright, multicolored flowers. When these are present, a shrine is sure to be nearby.
=== Oracle Effigy ===
The first Martyr Saint Shrine interacted with will grant the Tarnished the Oracle Effigy, allowing them to choose a Fortune from the list they have divined. The statue will also grant the Tarnished the three Basic Fortunes.
All Fortunes other than Basic must be either found by exploring the world, by defeating certain powerful enemies, or by unlocking them with an Oracle's Remedy at a Site of Grace.
=== Oracle's Remedy ===
Oracle's Remedies can be found at Martyr Saint Shrines. 
Oracle's Remedies allow the Tarnished to unlock a Common Fortune when resting at any Site of Grace, by accessing the Fortunes menu and then selecting a Common Fortune from the list. When you select a chosen Common Fortune, you will be given a preview of its features before being asked if you wish to unlock it. If you proceed to unlock it, this will use one Oracle's Remedy. 
There are more Oracle's Remedies in the world than there are Common Fortunes.

items.name: Minor Fortunes
items.description:
After defeating Royal Guardian Helicos in Leyndell, the Tarnished will receive the Phantasmal Effigy. This allows you to equip a Minor version of a Fortune at any Site of Grace.
Minor Fortunes can be equipped alongside your current Fortune. Minor Fortunes provide a weaker and more limited effect than the original Fortune, but do not have downsides. However, the selected Minor Fortune must not be the same as your current Fortune. For example, if you equip the Fortune of the Assassin, you can equip any Fortune you have alongside it as a Minor Fortune, except for the Fortune of the Assassin.

source.label: ERR wiki - Fortunes § Minor Fortunes

sections.title: Affinities
sections.summary:
Reforged alters vanilla armament affinities and also adds several new affinities, allowing all non-somber armaments to inflict any status effect or elemental damage type. 
Damage scaling of each existing affinity has been reworked, and every affinity now has an effect associated with it. Affinities have been changed to modify an armament's attribute scaling rather than overwrite it. This means each armament has effectively unique scaling combinations depending upon which affinity is applied. 
Passive effects from affinities are active so long as the armament is equipped in hand, even while two-handing an armament equipped in the opposite hand. On-hit effects, such as Magma's Frostbite interaction, will only activate if hitting with that armament.

Values verified for version 2.3.4.1 (per the wiki table caption).

items.name: Whetblades
items.description:
Affinities can be applied to armaments once a character has acquired the appropriate Whetblade. The new Fated Whetblade can apply the "Fated" affinity, a special affinity which applies unique combinations of scaling and effects to a valid armament. The Fated Whetblade can only be acquired after defeating a special endgame boss, or by purchasing it from the Starlight Token shop.
The Whetblade Fragment is a new item which can be found in Merchant Kalé's shop at the Church of Elleh in Limgrave. A Whetblade Fragment can only be used at the nearby anvil, and allows the player to unlock a single affinity without requiring its corresponding whetblade. Only two Whetblade Fragments can be bought from Kalé, and they can not be used to unlock the Fated affinity.
The location of the Red-Hot Whetblade has changed slightly: it remains in Redmane Castle, but is on the ground in the small courtyard outside its original room, guarded by an Abductor Virgin. Other Whetblades are in their original locations.

sections.title: Runeforging & Rune Pieces
sections.summary:
Runeforging is a new progression system introduced in ELDEN RING Reforged. 
Runeforging enables the creation of Binding Runes, a new category of items that grant passive boosts while held in the inventory.
To unlock the Runeforging system, a Great Rune must be acquired (even not restored) and 20 Rune Pieces must be presented to Finger Reader Enia in the Roundtable Hold. 
• Unlocking the system gives you the Fractured Great Rune key item that, upon being deposited in the storage chest disables the effects of all your Binding Runes.
• Having this item also allows you to manage Binding Runes at any site of grace.

items.name: Rune Pieces & Runic Traces
items.description:
Rune Pieces are collectible items scattered throughout the Lands Between and are used to create Binding Runes.
Rune Pieces are generally found in the more obscure and hidden corners of the world, so thorough exploration is recommended to collect as many of them as possible.
• Bosses also drop them, and will drop additional Pieces in NG+ cycles.
Runic Traces are simply a way of tracking the total number of Rune Pieces collected from world pick-ups so far. 
• Other methods of collection (such as killing bosses) do not grant Traces.
Reaching the level cap in NG+ replaces the level up menu at Sites of Grace with the option of purchasing Rune Pieces, Ember Pieces and Lost Ashes for 500000 runes each. 
=== Rune Piece Locations===
Rune Pieces are found scattered in the open world, in dungeons (such as caves, catacombs and Hero's Graves), in castles (such as Morne and Sol) and also in Legacy Dungeons. 
• Every dungeon has at least one Piece, with the larger ones having two or more.
There are, generally speaking, four types of Rune Piece locations: 
• Scattered around on non-descript cliff edges, inside ponds, and atop roofs. These are the easiest to access, obvious when nearby, and usually merely require looking at areas of the game world you may otherwise skip.
• In obscure corners and outcrops in dungeons, requiring more attention to your environment, especially looking up or down ledges and cliffs, or inside bushes and long grass. These are harder to notice but are usually straightforward to get once you know they're there.
• Inside breakable objects (such as vases, boxes and barrels). The orange glow of a Rune Piece is only intermittently visible when it is contained in an object, so it may be hard to notice.
• Requiring difficult platforming and parkour to get to, either on foot or by using Torrent. These are generally easy to find but getting to them is more challenging, both mechanically and logically. There are relatively few of these Rune Pieces. They are there for the most adventurous players.

items.name: Universal Character Changes
items.description:
Increased default Talisman and Spell slots by 1 (Golden Shade Godfrey no longer drops a Talisman pouch. No memory stones were removed, rather this change allows for the absolute engine-level maximum number of spell slots).
Almost all non-weapon buffs can now be stacked with each other. Very few buffs overwrite each other.
• This change reduces the amount of guesswork involved with figuring out what buffs you can use together, and allows for more varied usage of buffs.
• All buffs were rebalanced around this, so some may have lower individual effects.
• Stacking buffs with similar effects now has diminishing returns. 
• For example, in vanilla casting Golden Vow (+15% damage Aura buff) and Flame Grant Me Strength (+20% damage Body buff) would stack multiplicatively giving 1.15 x 1.2 = +38% damage, but Rallying Standard (+20% damage) couldn't be stacked since it's also an Aura buff. 
• In Reforged you can stack all 3 damage buffs, but Golden Vow is now +10% damage, FGMS is +12%, and Rallying Standard is +10%, which would normally result in 1.10 x 1.12 x 1.10 = +36% damage. However, with diminishing returns the 2nd damage buff only gives about 72% of it's value, and a 3rd buff only gives about 50% of it's value, for an actual total of 1.10 x 1.086 x 1.05 = +25% more damage.
• Weapon buffs still over-write each other, as stacking weapon buffs would allow for absurdly high damage output.
• All buffs are removed when resting at a site of grace.
Increased the healing done by various hpregen effects. Almost all sources of healing over time (AKA "regen") now have both flat healing and a % of max HP heal, allowing them to scale on Max HP.
hpregen effects can now be stacked.
• In vanilla, practically all hpregen effects overwrite each other. Only very select ones can be stacked normally, now all can be stacked.
• To balance this feature alongside the % healing hpregen effects have gained, regen effects have diminishing returns. Stacking healing will, of course, still be more effective than using any buff alone, just not to the point of invalidating enemy damage.
• Additionally, Spell/Skill based active hpregen effects (such as Blessing's Boon, Holy Ground, and Bestial Vitality) can now be stacked.
• Warning: Having lots of hpregen effects active can reduce the effectiveness of active HP recovery effects such as the Crimson Dagger talisman or Godskin Swaddling Cloth. 
Changed how poise buffs work.
• Some poise buffs in reforged are flat values instead of multipliers like in vanilla, for example Fortune of the Barbarian. This allows even light armor to gain substantial poise with those buffs.
• However to keep high poise setups in check, every flat poise buff causes "diminishing returns" to all other sources of poise
Changed the impact of falls. 
• The "medium" landing will now occur above 12m of falling distance, and the "heavy" landing above 16m, up from 4m and 8m respectively. 
• This results in a lot less slowdown when falling from various distances. 
• Fall damage, beginning at 16m, has not been changed. Additionally, the lethal fall threshold has not been changed.

items.description:
FP and stamina were changed to use a base 100 scale rather than base 10, meaning what would have been 50FP in vanilla is now 500FP.

items.name: Level Cap and Level Scaling
items.description:
The game now has a level cap of 200.
Vigor, Mind, and Endurance will now give more max HP, max FP, and max stamina respectively, beyond the original softcap of 60. 
• Scaling and progression for these stats has been completely reworked. Generally, they give slightly more early, less in the middle levels, and vastly more at high levels. 
• New level progression
Weapons will now benefit much more from higher levels of investment. Split scaling weapons and catalysts have been updated to require a similar level of investment as single stat scaling gear.
• In short: Any weapon with A or S scaling in a stat should benefit from going all the way to 80-99 of that stat. Weapons with a B or lower will benefit less from higher levels of a stat, but typically scale effectively with multiple stats. Affinities can be used to improve scaling.
• See the ERR Weapon Calculator to view exact scaling effectiveness for weapons.
Reduced the amount of alldefense and statusresistance gained from leveling.
Enemy rune drops have been increased to make higher levels more realistically achievable level in NG.

items.name: Vigor and HP
items.description:
Adjusted HP values have been adjusted to be roughly 2.3x the vanilla value at 99 vigor (2100 in vanilla to 4800 in reforged).

Increasing Vigor also slightly increases the drainspeed of Status Effects, from a minimum of 3 per second, up to a maximum of 4 per second at 99 Vigor.

items.name: Endurance and Stamina
items.description:
Endurance no longer increases equipload, which is now locked at a flat 100 and can only be increased by gear or conditional effects.
• See Combat Mechanics for extensive details on equipload.
Adjusted stamina values to be roughly 13x the vanilla value at 99 end (170 in vanilla to 2200 in reforged)
• Stamina costs for all actions have been adjusted mutually with this rescaling, and in turn the direct translation of stamina from vanilla to reforged of effective stamina will not come out to a 13x increase.
spregen speed now scales depending on Endurance, up to a 40% increase at 99 Endurance. 
Completely depleting your stamina bar will now apply a brief "Out of Stamina" penalty which reduces spregen considerably for a few seconds. This has a visual effect which is more intense in PvP.

items.name: Mind and FP
items.description:

• FP costs have been adjusted mutually with this rescaling, and in turn the direct translation of FP from vanilla to reforged of effective FP will not come out to a 8x increase.

Added the ability to restore FP by attacking enemies. This scales with the speed of the weapon, type of attack, Intelligence, and max FP. 
Added the ability to regenerate FP by hitting enemies via "Generator" spells. These restore both a flat amount of FP and a % of maximum FP.
Mind now scales cast speed, instead of Dexterity. See Spells.
Mind scales the duration of Spirit Fury, a new mechanic to do with Spirit Ashes. The base duration is 30 seconds at 1 Mind, scaling up to 50 seconds at 99 Mind.

items.name: Damage Attributes
items.description:
Reforged adds additional effects to all damage attributes, to allow builds to be more unique.
Strength increases poise damage, up to a maximum increase of 25%. Strength also increases physicaldefense somewhat more than other stats. 
Dexterity increases critical damage, up to a maximum increase of 50%. Dexterity also reduces the stamina cost of melee attacks and spells by up to 10%.
Intelligence increases the fpregen from attacks and spells, up to a maximum increase of 40%. Catalyst heavy attacks and generator spells also benefit from this fpregen, but at 25% the efficacy. Intelligence also increases elementaldefense somewhat more than other stats.
Faith increases the duration of Common Buffs (non-healing spells, ashes of war, consumables, Enkindled Ashes, and Armor Passives), up to a maximum increase of 60%. Faith also increases poise by up to 10%.
Arcane increases the amount of status buildup enemies take from all status effects, up to a maximum increase of 50%. Arcane also increases item discovery.
These effects increase all the way to 99 in a stat. See the ERR Level Progression spreadsheet for more details.

sections.title: Armament Upgrading
sections.summary:
Elden Ring Reforged substantially changes the general flow of upgrading armaments. Notably, Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearings have been removed from the game; instead, smithing stones may be bought from Smithing Master Hewg once at least one armament has been fully upgraded through that tier of smithing stone. The rune cost for armament upgrading has also been removed. 
The number of smithing stones required to upgrade a weapon has been adjusted:
• Regular armaments require 3 smithing stones per upgrade level, for a total of 9 smithing stones required for each smithing stone tier.
• Somber armaments require 3 smithing stones per upgrade level. 
With the exception of catalysts and weapon catalysts, armament scaling no longer increases with the armament's upgrade level. This allows players to more easily plan out builds and gauge equipment. Catalysts retain attribute scaling increases so that spell scaling upgrades appropriately. 
Armaments have generally had their scaling values increased and their base damage decreased, causing scaling to play a greater role in armament damage. Upgrading a melee armament does increase its status buildup, reaching a 25% boost at +25/+10. Base level armaments also have a 25% reduced stamina cost for all actions, including blocking attacks. This gradually fades as the armament is upgraded, reducing the need to level Endurance in the early game. Similarly, the FP cost of skills, spells and items is reduced at lower armament levels, with a 12.5% reduction at base upgrade level.

Armament attribute scaling (E to S+) no longer changes with armament reinforcement level but instead always uses the maximum scaling regardless of reinforcement. This means an armament with A scaling in Strength at +25 (or +10 for somber armaments) will also have A scaling at +0. This makes it easier to determine how a weapon will work within your build without any unnecessary guesswork. However, catalysts, including weapon catalysts, still increase their scaling with weapon level, as this is the only way to make them upgrade. 
The base damage of armaments has been reduced but their stat scaling has been greatly increased. This results in most of an armament's damage coming from your stats rather than smithing stones. Although both remain important for an armament to be fully effective. 
For characters investing incredibly heavily in bar stats (Vigor, Mind, and Endurance) and less in damage stats, it's recommended to experiment with status effects, as they deal percent health damage output and can make up for lower up-front damage. Crossbows are also largely stat agnostic. Additionally, Spirit Ashes can be a great asset to damage if you have the FP to consistently enrage them and the Mind to extend the duration of their rage.

items.name: Smithing Master Hewg
items.description:
Unlimited smithing stones of both varieties are now purchased from Smithing Master Hewg. In order to unlock a tier of smithing stones for purchase, an armament must first be fully upgraded through that tier of smithing stones, e.g. once a normal armament has been upgraded to +3, unlimited Smithing Stone [1] becomes available at Hewg.
Ancient Dragon Smithing Stones of either variety are only available for unlimited purchase after the Elden Beast has been defeated.
Once an armament has been fully upgraded through a tier of smithing stones, the armament should be swapped in and out of an active hand to unlock the relevant smithing stone(s) for purchase. Alternately, the same can be achieved by having the armament in hand during travel which triggers a loading screen or reloading the save. The player is notified when new smithing stones are unlocked with the message "New smithing stones can be purchased from Smithing Master Hewg". 
=== Other NPCs ===
==== Kalé ====
Kalé's smithing table in the Church of Elleh can now strengthen armaments to +25/+10 and allows the player to use Whetblade Fragments.
==== Smithing Master Iji ====
Smithing Master Iji, found by the Road to the Manor Site of Grace in Liurnia, can also upgrade armaments. Iji no longer sells any somber smithing stones, instead offering the Spellsmith's Etching Tool and 20 Lost Ashes, among other wares.
==== Smithing Master Sfyrix ====
Blacksmith Sfyrix is a new blacksmith who resides behind Castle Sol in the Mountaintops of the Giants. Like Iji, he doesn't offer any smithing stones, but can upgrade the player's armaments and sells 30 Lost Ashes, among other wares.

items.name: World Pickups
items.description:
Smithing stones of both varieties have been redistributed around the map to better match game progression. For example, in Limgrave, Somber/Smithing Stones [1]s are readily available, while Somber/Smithing [2]s are abundant in Weeping Peninsula, Somber/Smithing [3]s become plentiful in Liurnia, and so on. More somber smithing stones have been added to the game in the form of somber scarabs to help meet the higher amounts of somber stones required for upgrades.
Chests found in the cellars of many ruins now contain a region-appropriate smithing stone in addition to their normal drops, to further encourage exploration. Bosses in optional dungeons generally also drop region-appropriate smithing stones alongside their other rewards. "Catch up" stones have also been placed: lower-tier stones than expected for a region, usually in very obvious locations to help finish off upgrade tiers. 
Some easily accessible early high-tier smithing stones (notably, in Dragonbarrow) have been replaced with stones more appropriate for the point in the game at which they're expected to be found. Alongside other changes to item placements and drops, this means there is now no 'route' to quickly get a +25/+10 armament early on.
"Chair corpse" smithing stones have been replaced with Signs of the All-Knowing.
A community-maintained spreadsheet recording the locations of Somber/Smithing Stone pickups throughout the world can be found here.

==== Hard Enemy Effects ====
On Hard, Master, Co-op Hard/Master/Raid, and any Special difficulties that list it: 
• Some Bosses and a small number of Elite Enemies have "Hard" AI (new attack effects and new strings/combos) and are more aggressive. These are not new attacks, rather new combinations of existing attacks and modifiers to existing attacks. 
• For example, Margit will throw a spread of 3 daggers rather than just one, to prevent the player from simply strafing the attack.
• Some basic enemies will gain faster cancel windows for some attacks. This will will allow them to act more quickly out of certain animations. This is primarily present on very simple enemies such as Giant Crabs, Scaly Misbegotten, and Trolls.
• This does not increase their aggression, it simply reduces the length of the punish window on very safe attacks.
• Enemies begin to slowly recover their health after a few seconds of not getting hit. Aggressive play prevents this from happening.
• Use of ranged attacks (such as consumables, an offhand Throwing Blade, skills like Spectral Lance, or shortbows) can be extremely useful to prevent enemies' HP and stance regeneration during windows where melee attacks are difficult to perform.
• Enemy regen will be paused during attacks where attacking them isn't feasible even with these options, such as dragons flying long distances away or into the air, or bosses that vanish temporarily.
• If an enemy is fully alerted, it becomes immune to backstabs.
• Upon dying and retrieving your lost runes, 10% of them will be gone. This is usually referred to as "rune decay".

items.description:
Adventure Mode replaces fast traveling to sites of grace with waygate teleportation between the Roundtable Hold and certain points in the Lands Between and Realm of Shadow. This creates an experience similar to the original Dark Souls, with limited warp points and no ability to freely escape to a grace. 
There are 34 gateways in the Lands Between, and 13 in the Realm of Shadow.

items.name: Eternal Return Challenge
items.description: Eternal Return is a game mode focused on NPC quests. Cursed by the Three Fingers, you only have three (in-game) days to become Elden Lord before the flame consumes you and Order is lost forever. Players must empower themselves with Grace found from interacting with and completing NPC quests to become Elden Lord.

source.label: ERR wiki - Difficulties and Game Modes

items.name: Additional Enemies
items.description:
Additional Enemies is an in-development feature which can be accessed via a toggleable option inside the Knight's Study of the Gilded Court. It adds a variety of enemies to most of the dungeons and legacy dungeons throughout the game. Each enemy is manually placed in an effort to create new and interesting enemy encounters inside familiar dungeons, and often includes enemies not seen in that dungeon. This includes DLC enemies inside base-game dungeons.
The enemies added have a slight green tint to distinguish them from the ordinary enemies present in that dungeon.

sections.title: Spirit Ashes & Spirit Fury
sections.summary:
The Spirit Ash system has been substantially rebalanced in Reforged, especially with the addition of Spirit Fury. Spirit Ashes now require more substantial investment in Mind in order to be most effective, and will not trivialize most boss encounters like in vanilla merely upon being summoned, allowing them to be a more carefully considered part of any build. 
Additionally, Reforged adds multiple new Spirit Ashes and has reworked the numbers on many existing ones.

items.name: Spirit Fury
items.description:
Spirit Ashes are now "Passive" by default when summoned. When passive, the following effects apply to all spirit ashes:
• Very low damage output.
• Very high damage reduction.
• Reduced status buildup.
• Passive ashes cannot stagger or flatten enemies.
• Passive ashes are completely ignored by enemies unless no other targets exist (I.E. you're too far away for the enemy to engage you).
Passive ashes are intended to be background companions. They do limited damage and cannot draw enemies away from you, but are very cheap to summon and can provide supportive effects such as status effects, buffs, or supplemental DPS.
Using the Spirit Ash again while it is already summoned will "Enrage" the ash for twice theFP cost of the initial summon. This has the following effects.
• Vastly increased damage output (5x compared to passive, typically roughly 2x vanilla damage values).
• Normal damage reduction.
• Vastly increased target priority.
• Note: Some spirit ashes will receive a smaller target priority boost, such as Latenna. This is because these summons are not meant to draw excessive aggro, and are typically fragile. You still need to keep up your attacks or enemies will go after them!
• Heals the Sprit Ash for 10% of their max HP. This activates every time you Enrage.
This Enraged state lasts for a limited time, after which the spirit will calm again. Enraging can be repeated indefinitely, as long as you have enough FP. High levels of Mind, Generator Spells, and fpregen boosts can allow for near-indefinite uptime.
Mind scales the duration of Spirit Fury. The base duration is 30 seconds at 1 Mind, scaling up to 40 seconds at 99 Mind.
• Certain spirit ashes will act differently in Passive state versus Enraged state, generally switching to more aggressive and direct attacks when Enraged.
• Certain spirit ashes with powerful buffs or debuffs may use these much less frequently while passive.
• Certain spirit ashes will perform specific attacks or skills immediately upon being enraged.

source.label: ERR wiki - Spirit Ashes § Spirit Fury

items.name: General Changes
items.description:
The initial summon costs for spirit summons has been greatly reduced.
Spirit Ashes will now scale with NG+ cycles.
Using the Spiritcalling Bell is now faster and can be done while moving.
Spirit summons are now vulnerable to status effects.
• The status effects a spirit summon is vulnerable to depends on what the normal version of that enemy is vulnerable to.
• This change makes choosing which spirit summon to pick against status afflicting enemies more interesting.
Increased the strength of the early levels of Spirit Ash reinforcement, removing the power spike that later levels of reinforcement gained, making reinforcement a more steady upgrade process.
Replaced some early high-level Gloveworts with lower level ones. A community-maintained, comprehensive spreadsheet of world pickups for Grave/Ghost gloveworts can be found here.
=== "Depleted" Spirit Ashes ===
Due to item changes from vanilla to Reforged, it may occur that your Spirit Ashes show as "depleted". These are outdated versions of the Spirit Ashes.
• If you have "depleted spirit ashes" in your inventory: Go into the Reforged options at a Site of Grace, navigate to "Compatibility", and select the "Restore depleted spirit ashes" option. After fast traveling, your Spirit Ashes will be restored.
• If you have "depleted spirit ashes" in your quick item slots, but your inventory is fine: Simply re-assign the slots to the new, un-depleted versions of the ash.

source.label: ERR wiki - Spirit Ashes § General Changes

sections.title: New Bosses
sections.summary:
Elden Ring Reforged adds several new bosses to the game. Some of these bosses are entirely new encounters, while others replace less interesting bosses. Additionally, many changes are made to existing bosses, including AI, hitbox, and camera alterations, and in some cases, entirely new attacks based on cut content.
Additionally, the player now has the ability to freely resurrect bosses at the Roundtable Hold, allowing you to challenge them any number of times.
An endgame boss rush mode called the Trial of Recollection has also been added, to demonstrate your mastery over the game's many boss encounters.

items.name: Asimi, Nascent Lord
items.description: Wrapped in enchanted silks, her transformation interrupted, she defends herself, surrendered to her people's will. Conflicted over the necessity of your battle, and the bonds you shared, her swings seem lethargic, even labored.

source.label: ERR wiki - Asimi, Nascent Lord

items.name: Azash, Pride of the Redmanes
items.description:
__NOTOC__
Azash, Pride of the Redmanes is a new boss found in the plaza at the end of Redmane Castle that replaces the Leonine Misbegetton and Crucible Knight. That fight, and its drops, have been moved outside of Redmane Castle.
Its moveset is that of an elder lion, but it additionally has fire effects on attacks, as well as creating fire surfaces that damage you. It can also inflict bleed with its bite attacks.
To mark the beginning of Phase 2, and occasionally during the rest of the fight, he will jump into the air and crash down with a powerful fireball attack.

source.label: ERR wiki - Azash, Pride of the Redmanes

items.description:
__NOTOC__
Crucible Knight Hirnan is a new boss located after the Night Sky Unceasing waygate at the Four Belfries in Liurnia. 
Hirnan is an endgame fight, but can be fought at any time.

items.name: Crucible Knight Rhyacis
items.description:
Crucible Knight Rhyacis is a new boss added at the end of the Gilded Cave of Knowledge, the area that replaces the Cave of Knowledge. 
Rhyacis is a unique boss, in that he cannot be directly damaged. Instead, you must demonstrate your dodging abilities by successfully avoiding his attacks to deal damage to his healthbar. Repeated failure to dodge will allow him to slowly regenerate his healthbar. He does very little damage, however, so as to not overly punish your attempts to learn.
Rhyacis must be defeated to access Hard Mode and Master Mode in the options at Sites of Grace.

source.label: ERR wiki - Crucible Knight Rhyacis

items.description:
__NOTOC__
The Dismounted Tree Sentinel is a new boss found on the Bridge of Sacrifice, located between Limgrave and the Weeping Peninsula. It is counted as a Weeping Peninsula boss in terms of scaling and boss resurrection.

Equilibrious Beast is a new boss found at the end of the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds. It replaces Mohg, the Omen.
Equilibrious Beast is an adapted version of the Nightlord Libra, from Nightreign. The first phase consists of Libra's mixed melee-casting moveset. At 70% HP, Libra enters an invulnerable meditation, in which you must break his sigils. This maddens him and allows you to damage him once more.

items.name: Fallen Cavalry
items.description:

The Fallen Cavalry is a new boss found on the broken bridge leading to the shortcut from northern Limgrave to southern Liurnia. 
It is a halberd Night Cavalry unit, but it starts without its horse and cannot summon it. Unlike other Night Cavalry, it is constantly present on the bridge, night and day.

items.description:
__NOTOC__
The Fellthorn Spirit is a new boss. One is located in the Giant's Gravepost, north of the Foot of the Forge Site of Grace. The other is located in Ashen Leyndell, after backtracking from the Forbidden Lands, where the three Ulcerated Tree Spirits once were.
The Fellthorn Spirits are large, trident-wielding creatures which gain the ability to use fire attacks once they reach about 80% health. They additionally inflict bleed upon striking you with their trident.

source.label: ERR wiki - Fellthorn Spirit

items.name: Flamelost Knight
items.description: __NOTOC__The Flamelost Knights are a new boss added in Elden Ring Reforged 2.0, which can be found at the end of the Serpentine Depths after giving all three offerings to the altar at the Sacrificial Chasm of Old site of grace.

source.label: ERR wiki - Flamelost Knight

Fulghor, Champion of Rauh is a new boss accessed from the Castle Ensis belfry waygate. It replaces a Divine Bird Warrior.

items.description:
__NOTOC__
The Fulminating Runebear is a new boss in Liurnia of the Lakes, found in some ruins northeast of the Sorcerer's Isle.
Its moveset is that of a runebear, but it has additional lightning effects on some attacks. This, in combination with the fulgurbloom field around it, makes this boss dangerous to fight in the water, as lightning spreads on water.

source.label: ERR wiki - Fulminating Runebear

items.description:
Gaping Jaw is a new boss found in Yelough Anix Tunnel. It replaces Astel, Stars of Darkness as the dungeon's boss.
Gaping Jaw is an adapted version of Adel, Baron of Night from Elden Ring Nightreign.

source.label: ERR wiki - Gaping Jaw

Gnoster, the False Sky is a new boss found in Nokron, at the end of the Siofra Aqueduct. It replaces the Valiant Gargoyle duo.
Gnoster is an adapted version of the Nightlord of the same name from Nightreign. Like the Nightlord, it consists of two phases. The fight begins in a duo phase, with the Stoneshield Scorpion on the ground and the Gnoster Moth flying in the sky. Bringing the health of the Scorpion or the Moth to zero will cause the second phase to begin.
In its second phase, the Moth lands on the Scorpion and becomes a single entity, with attacks from the first phase mixed with new ones

source.label: ERR wiki - Gnoster, the False Sky

items.name: Grave Sentinel Wyngrant
items.description:
__NOTOC__
Grave Sentinel Wyngrant is a new boss at the end of the Sainted Hero's Grave that replaces the Ancient Hero of Zamor. 
Its moveset is very similar to that of the Dragonslayer Armor from Dark Souls 3, featuring shield bashes and horizontal and overhead swipes. 
Unlike the earlier Dismounted Tree Sentinel, Wyngrant possesses some of the more dangerous parts of Dragonslayer Armor's moveset, such as his charging attacks and area of effect slams, but with a holy theme instead of lightning. These attacks come out mostly in Phase 2.

items.description:
__NOTOC__
The Hallowed Avatar is a new boss that is only accessible after defeating the final boss of Elden Ring and choosing an ending without immediately transitioning into NG+. 
The Hallowed Avatar possesses the combined buffs and abilities of every Erdtree Avatar in the game, and this, plus its relatively high health, makes it a challenging fight.

__NOTOC__
Morion, The Unbound Death is a new boss in Dragonbarrow, found on the Farum Greatbridge to the Bestial Sanctum.
They have a similar move set to other dragons, however his breath attack uses the Destined Death visuals and effects.

The Nox Nightmaiden is a new boss found at the ground level in the Night's Sacred Ground section of Nokron, and must be defeated in order to obtain the Fingerslayer Blade. 
The battle against the Nightmaiden begins as normal. However, upon reaching approximately 60% health, the Nightmaiden will become undamageable and summon one of five possible mimics to help defeat you. Royal Guardian Helicos is a new boss found in Leyndell, Royal Capital, inside the Erdtree Sanctuary. He replaces the golden shade of Godfrey, First Elden Lord.

The Sovereign Eternal is a new Remembrance boss found in The Black Cradle. She is the final boss of the dungeon.

Thief-Taker Acacio is a new boss inside the Malefactor's Evergaol in southern Liurnia, replacing Adan, Thief of Fire.

items.name: Boss Resurrection
items.description:
This feature allows you to resurrect bosses and fight them again, accessible from the Roundtable Hold Site of Grace. Any currently supported bosses will automatically appear in the menu once defeated.
You must travel to most boss to re-fight them, though certain bosses with very significant runbacks, such as some catacomb bosses, will give the option to warp directly to them.
You may resurrect as many bosses at a time as you wish, with no cost.
This is a good way to practice difficult bosses, acquire extra runes, and mark bosses for the Codex of the All Knowing.

items.name: Church of Vengeance
items.description: The Church of Vengeance is a new area within southern Stormhill, southwest of the Stormhill Evergaol, overlooking Limegrave's western beach. These dilapidated ruins contain the Redeemer's Plated Finger, as well as the Gracebound Greatsword and the Gracebound Round Shield.

items.name: Serpentine Depths
items.description:
The Serpentine Depths are a new dungeon in Mt. Gelmir, initially accessed via a side path in Seethewater Cave. This labyrinth of winding tunnels and lava-strewn caves contains a variety of new items and new bosses.

You can obtain a hint as to how to reach this area from the Mt. Gelmir merchant just before the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace.
To access this area, you must first enter the Seethewater Cave in Mt. Gelmir. Before you take the plunge down the hole to the boss, instead veer into a side tunnel which contains frenzied rats and a frenzied Leyndell Knight, then go further into a room with wooden scaffolding and a pile of explosive barrels in the corner. Use fire damage to explode these barrels and unveil the entrance to the Serpentine Depths.

items.description:
The Black Cradle is a new dungeon in the vicinity of Nokron, accessible by progressing its associated new questline and by defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade in the main game's story progression. This extensive underground cityscape contains a variety of puzzles and hidden pathways, as well as new items, new enemies and new bosses.

sections.title: Other Systems
sections.summary: Other ERR systems relevant to builds.

items.name: Talisman slots and weight
items.description:
All talismans now have zero weight.
All classes now start with 2 talisman slots. The third slot is unlocked upon defeating Margit, the Fell Omen, while the fourth slot is unlocked by speaking to Finger Reader Enia in Roundtable Hold after acquiring two Great Runes.

source.label: ERR wiki - Talismans § General Changes

items.name: Shadowed Curio
items.description:
Shadowed Curios are a new, permanent progression system found in the Realm of Shadow that allow you to upgrade very specific, active portions of your build (unlike the passive boosts of Binding Runes) and typically provide some moderately sized temporary buff upon performing a specific action.
• Each Curio lets you choose and strengthen one of three unique effects that occur upon the trigger condition.
• Curios will function both inside and outside the Shadow Realm, unlike Scadutree Blessing.
• Curios can be re-sealed at any site of grace. This will disable its effect and refund all spent Ember Pieces. 
Shadowed Curios must be found throughout the Shadow Realm. Some are found as item pickups, while for others you must defeat certain enemies.

Each Shadowed Curio can be unlocked at the cost of 50 Ember Pieces, which are glowing red collectables found throughout the Shadow Realm, and are found in similarly obscure locations as Rune Pieces in the Lands Between. You can additionally obtain Ember Pieces by defeating bosses. 
To unlock a Shadowed Curio, you must go to the Strengthen Character menu at a site of grace and select Shadowed curios. You will then be given a choice between three options, allowing you to choose the most relevant effect for your build and playstyle.
Each effect can be further strengthened by two ranks. To see exactly what strengthening the Shadowed Curio achieves, check their respective pages below. Each rank costs a further 25 Ember Pieces; therefore, a fully upgraded Shadowed Curio will cost you a total of 100 Ember Pieces.
• It is possible to fully upgrade all nine Shadowed Curios (with one effect each), but not in a single NG cycle due to the limited number of Ember Pieces.
In total, there are approximately 250 Ember Pieces as ground pickups in the Realm of Shadow. The community is compiling a list of these ember pieces in this interactive map:

source.label: ERR wiki - Shadowed Curio

items.name: Camps
items.description:
Camps are new locations added in Reforged, spread around the Lands Between and Realm of Shadow. 
Each camp has several enemies, including one or more camp leaders, which can be easily distinguished by their glowing red eyes. Defeating the camp leader(s) will unlock a camp chest, which usually contains weapons or armor.

Upon approaching a camp, you will be dismounted from Torrent and become unable to summon him until you travel some distance from the camp or complete the camp.
Within each camp, you will find a locked chest as well as one or more enemies with glowing red eyes. These enemies are the camp's leaders and must all be defeated to unlock the camp's chest. Camp leaders have increased stats and increase the awareness of nearby enemies when they themselves are alerted.
Once all leaders are defeated, a message telling you the camp's chest has opened will appear. At this point, you will be able to use Torrent again. Finding and opening the camp's chest will award you with a themed set of items - often a full armour set or selection of weapons. Typically, camp rewards are items that can be farmed from enemies. However, due to now being accessible via camps they have had their drop rates drastically reduced to reduce inventory clutter. This makes completing camps a much more reliable way to acquire these items without having to rely on RNG.
Resting at a Site of Grace once a camp is complete will cause all the enemies within it (including the ones who were marked as leaders) to respawn. However their leader status, the chest, and Torrent being disabled when nearby will not reset.

source.label: ERR wiki - Camps

items.name: Ash of War Enkindling
items.description:
Enkindling is a system added in Elden Ring Reforged that allows you to upgrade your Ashes of War with new and interesting passive effects, repurposing the Lost Ashes of War (now called Lost Ashes) found throughout the world.

Ash of War Enkindling replaces the Ash of War duplication menu at Smithing Master Hewg, using the Lost Ashes currency.
When an Ash of War is enkindled, you will be granted an extra copy of it.
• This copy will have a random rarity of Common, Rare or Legendary, represented respectively by 1, 2 or 3 stars on the Ash of War icon, as well as a random Affix which will grant powerful benefits (see the section below).
• 3-star (Legendary) Enkindled Ashes of War can also be equipped on Somber weapons of the appropriate weapon class: this allows more varied builds with weapons that are upgraded via Somber Smithing Stones.
• "No Skill" can always be equipped on Somber weapons, even without any Enkindling.
• Weapon Catalysts are considered weapons for Enkindled Ashes' compatibility.
Unwanted Enkindled Ashes of War can be sold for runes (1000/4000/16000 respectively for Common/Rare/Legendary).
Each Enkindled Ash of War purchased also produces a Residual Ashes item. Once 100 Residual Ashes are obtained, they can be traded for 3-star Enkindled Ashes of War.
For a list of the Ashes of War that can be placed on staves and seals, see this table.
===Lost Ashes Availability ===
• Added to replace many generic crafting ingredients or corpse loot pickups in the world.
• To make them stand out more, they have been upgraded to Legendary rarity.
• Guaranteed chest reward for each cleared Camp.
• Available for purchase in large quantities from Smithing Master Iji (20), Blacksmith Sfyrix (30) and Forsaken Merchant (50).
• Also available at a few merchants around the world (see this page).
• New Game Plus (NG+) unlocks a shop, available at every site of grace, where you can purchase unlimited Lost Ashes for 500000 runes each.
• Lost Ashes have a very small chance to drop from powerful enemies.
• This chance is not affected by item discovery.
• Reward for defeating at least two bosses in the Trial of Recollection (based on the chosen difficulty and number of defeated bosses).
• Unlocked after defeating Elden Beast or in New Game Plus (NG+) and infinitely repeatable, making it one of the best sources in the end-game.

source.label: ERR wiki - Ash of War Enkindling

items.name: Spellcasting changes
items.description:
Every spell has received rebalancing for Damage, stamina cost, memoryslot cost, and FP cost. 
Characters start with one extra memoryslot, for a maximum of 14. This is the maximum number of memoryslots the game supports. The Moon of Nokstella talisman will now grant you maximum memoryslots. 
Each spell cast will initially consume FP based on and then regenerate some FP over one second. This effect is based on the number of memoryslot the spell requires:
• 0-slot (Generator): 0.2% max FP penalty, then 0.5% max FP + 4
• 1-slot: 0.4% max FP penalty, then 1% max FP + 12
• 2-slot: 0.8% max FP penalty, then 1.5% max FP + 20
• 3-slot: 1.6% max FP penalty, then 2% max FP + 28
The range of support Incantations has been increased so affecting allies is more consistent.
Casting a spell will now very slightly increase the damage of other spells for an extended time. This is not visible as a buff and applis separately for every spell.
• This provides an incentive to use a wider variety of spells in a given loadout.
Boosts to specific spell schools from weapon effects now cannot stack if they are both the same potency.
• For example, Cinqueda's boost to Beast Incantations can stack with the Clawmark Seal, but wielding 2 Beastclaw Seals would not allow them to stack.
buff duration increasing effects do not affect hpregen effects, including from spells.
 All spells that increase a weapons' damage or status have a base value listed on the spell, but is modified by the weapon class, with slower weapon types getting a higher amount than listed, while faster weapons getting a lower amount than listed. For more information check the Buffing Weapons section on Weapons
=== Cast Speed ===
Greatly increased the speed of most spell casting animations. Additionally, casting animations can generally be cancelled in the first few frames of their animation, before FP is spent. The animations can also be cancelled more quickly after firing. Certain spells have had range adjustments to account for these safer cast animations.
castspeednl will improve how quickly spells may transition into weapon skills and attacks. This allows for hybrid melee + spell casting builds to benefit more from castspeednl.
The castspeednl stat now works on a scale from 1 to 250 instead of the original 10 to 70 points. Mind now governs cast speed instead of Dexterity, up to +125 at 99 Mind. 
Players start with 50 castspeednl. 
Some catalysts provide a bonus or penalty to castspeednl when used: 
• Academy Glintstone Staff: +25
• Azur's Glintstone Staff: +50
• Clawmark Seal: +25
• Dryleaf Seal: +25
• Staff of the Great Beyond: +25
• Scepter of the All-Knowing: +25
• Giant's Seal: -25

• Rotten Crystal Staff: -25
The Radagon Icon talisman provides +100 points.
The Faithful/Flock Canvas Talisman give +25/50 points.
The Tainted Projection rune also gives up to +50 points.
=== Healing Decay ===
The spells that provide an instantaneous burst of HP are subject to a "healing decay" mechanic, wherein repeat usage of these spells progressively reduces their effectiveness until resting at a grace. Healing decay decreases received from affected spells by -1.25% per stack, capping at 40 stacks for -50% healing effectiveness. The following spells are affected:
• Urgent Heal: 1 stack per cast
• Heal: 2 stacks per cast
• Great Heal: 3 stacks per cast
• Lord's Heal: 4 stacks per cast
• Order Healing: 2 stacks per cast
• Erdtree Heal: 5 stacks per cast

items.name: Generator spells
items.description:
generatornl spells are a new category of spells that do decreased damage but will generate FP on hit and do not take any memoryslot to equip.
• These spells allow you to regenerate without using flasks, giving spellcasters more sustainability while fighting.
• Generators can be recognized by the blue drop in the bottom right corner of their spell icon.
• Each spell tool has a built-in generator spell that can be accessed by performing a heavy attack. These spells cost zero FP.
Generators restore both flat FP and a percentage of your max FP on hit. 
• The exact restoration varies per spell, depending on the attack speed (check the tables below).
=== Generator Sorceries ===
Name | Spell Type | FP on hit | Effect
Ambush Shard | Night | 1.02% + 102 | Launches a projectile from a distance removed from the caster, so as to strike the enemy from behind
Blasphemous Spark (new) | Magma | 1.76% + 176 | Sparks a stream of blasphemous flame to scorch foes
Carian Slicer | Carian | 0.95% + 95 | Conjures a magic sword and delivers a swift sweeping slash
Glintstone Pebble | Glintstone | 0.94% + 94 | The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching magical projectiles at foes
Glintstone Snowdrift (new) | Cold | 1.12% + 112 | The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching a deluge of freezing projectiles at foes
Rancor (new) | Ghostflame | 0.98% + 98 | Summons a vengeful spirit that chases down foes
Stone Sling (new) | Gravity | 1.92% + 192 | Pulls a stone from the earth and sends it flying
=== Generator Incantations ===
Name | Spell Type | FP on hit | Effect
Bestial Sling | Bestial | 0.96% + 96 | Swiftly flings a number of sharp rock shards
Catch Flame | Giants' Flame / Godslayer (Godslayer's Seal) | 1.06% + 106 | Momentarily sparks flame from the caster's hand
Dragonrend (new) | Dragon Communion | 1.01% + 101 | Creates dragon claw lacerations to cleave foes
Golden Star (new) | Erdtree | 1.53% + 153 | Creates a golden shooting star that homes in on targets
Honed Bolt | Dragon Cult | 1.14% + 114 | Summons a bolt of lightning to strike foes from above
Retch Gore (new) | Blood Oath | 1.71% + 171 | Ejects a cone of vile blood from the caster's mouth
Scarlet Papillon (new) | Servants of Rot | 1.67% + 167 | Brings forth a swarm of scarlet butterflies. The butterflies descend nearby, inflicting minor scarlet rot buildup

items.name: Skill changes (general)
items.description:
• Significant action speed increases to nearly all Skills.
• This allows Skills to be used more opportunistically or as mixups, and further diversifies them from charged attacks.
• Skill strength is generally increased, but costs greater amounts of FP.
• This helps to deter skill spamming and is complemented by Elden Ring Reforged's changes to FP recovery.
• Most Ashes of War base their effect damage on their own scaling, overriding the weapon's.
• Bows of all types can now generally equip Ashes of War valid for "All Armaments". Weapon catalysts can equip Ashes of War valid for their moveset/original armament class.
